name: Stagehand
summary: Browser automation SDK for AI agents with TypeScript, Python and Go drivers and Playwright-style APIs.
description: An SDK for browser agents with Playwright-style methods (goto, click, locator, screenshot) plus AI actions act, observe and extract that refresh their behaviour when a site changes underneath. One complete driver exists for TypeScript, Python and Go; runs go against local Chrome or the Browserbase cloud, and a hosted MCP server gives coding agents a browser without a local install.
contains: Playwright-style methods: goto, click, locator, screenshot
self-healing act, observe and extract actions
hosted MCP server gives coding agents a browser
runs locally in Chrome or on Browserbase cloud
search and fetch APIs without a browser
